title: 報告與簡報
description: 做報告與簡報時的實用句型

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone; today I will be presenting our quarterly results, which demonstrate significant growth across all major business segments.
sentences.zh: 大家早安；今天我將報告我們的季度業績，這些結果顯示所有主要業務領域都有顯著成長。

sentences.en: Before I dive into the details of the report, I would like to provide some background context that will help you understand the data more clearly.
sentences.zh: 在我深入報告細節之前，我想提供一些背景脈絡，幫助大家更清楚地理解這些數據。

sentences.en: As you can see from the chart displayed on the screen, our customer acquisition rate has increased by thirty-five percent compared to the same period last year.
sentences.zh: 如螢幕上顯示的圖表所示，與去年同期相比，我們的客戶獲取率增加了百分之三十五。

sentences.en: The data I am about to present, gathered from multiple sources over the past six months, reveals several important trends that require our immediate attention.
sentences.zh: 我即將呈現的數據——在過去六個月從多個來源收集——揭示了幾個需要我們立即關注的重要趨勢。

sentences.en: Having analyzed the feedback collected from over two thousand respondents, we can confidently conclude that customer satisfaction has improved substantially this quarter.
sentences.zh: 在分析了從兩千多位受訪者收集的回饋後，我們可以有信心地得出結論：本季客戶滿意度已大幅提升。

sentences.en: I would like to draw your attention to the third column of this table, which highlights the cost savings achieved through our newly implemented procurement strategy.
sentences.zh: 我想請大家注意這張表格的第三欄，它突顯了透過我們新實施的採購策略所實現的成本節約。

sentences.en: To put these numbers into perspective, let me compare them with the industry benchmarks that were published in the latest market research report.
sentences.zh: 為了讓這些數字更有意義，讓我將它們與最新市場研究報告中發布的行業基準進行比較。

sentences.en: The next slide illustrates the project timeline, including the critical milestones that must be achieved in order to meet our target launch date in September.
sentences.zh: 下一張投影片展示了專案時程，包括為了達到我們九月目標上市日期而必須達成的關鍵里程碑。

sentences.en: Although we encountered several unexpected challenges during the implementation phase, the team managed to deliver the project within budget and ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 儘管我們在實施階段遇到了幾個意外的挑戰，團隊仍成功在預算內且提前完成了專案交付。

sentences.en: In summary, the three key takeaways from today's presentation are: first, revenue growth is strong; second, costs are declining; and third, market share is expanding.
sentences.zh: 總結來說，今天簡報的三個重點是：第一，營收成長強勁；第二，成本正在下降；第三，市場份額正在擴大。

sentences.en: If you look at the pie chart on the right side of the slide, you will notice that our Asia-Pacific region now accounts for nearly forty percent of total sales.
sentences.zh: 如果您看投影片右側的圓餅圖，會注意到我們的亞太地區現在佔總銷售額的近百分之四十。

sentences.en: The findings of this analysis, conducted in collaboration with our external consultants, suggest that we should reallocate resources toward digital marketing initiatives.
sentences.zh: 這項與我們外部顧問合作進行的分析結果顯示，我們應該將資源重新分配到數位行銷計畫上。

sentences.en: Before moving on to the next section, are there any questions about the methodology we used to calculate the return on investment figures presented here?
sentences.zh: 在進入下一個部分之前，對於我們用來計算此處呈現的投資報酬率數據的方法有任何問題嗎？

sentences.en: I would now like to hand over to my colleague, who will walk you through the technical specifications and demonstrate how the new system operates in practice.
sentences.zh: 現在我想交給我的同事，他將帶大家了解技術規格並演示新系統在實際中如何運作。

sentences.en: The graph clearly shows an upward trend that began in the third quarter, coinciding with the launch of our revised pricing strategy and enhanced customer support.
sentences.zh: 圖表清楚顯示了從第三季開始的上升趨勢，這與我們修訂的定價策略和增強的客戶支援推出的時間一致。

sentences.en: Based on the projections generated by our forecasting model, we anticipate that annual revenue will exceed two hundred million dollars by the end of next fiscal year.
sentences.zh: 根據我們預測模型生成的預估，我們預計年收入將在下一個財政年度結束前超過兩億美元。

sentences.en: It is worth noting that the improvement in employee retention rates, highlighted in this section, can be attributed to the wellness programs introduced last January.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，本節中強調的員工留任率改善，可歸因於去年一月推出的健康計畫。

sentences.en: The comparison between our current performance and our competitors', as shown in this benchmark analysis, reveals that we have a clear advantage in customer service.
sentences.zh: 如這份基準分析所示，我們目前的表現與競爭對手的比較顯示，我們在客戶服務方面具有明顯的優勢。

sentences.en: Allow me to elaborate on the risk factors that could potentially impact our projections, particularly the supply chain disruptions that have been affecting the entire industry.
sentences.zh: 讓我詳細說明可能影響我們預測的風險因素，特別是一直影響整個行業的供應鏈中斷問題。

sentences.en: This concludes the financial overview section of my presentation; I will now transition to discussing our strategic initiatives planned for the upcoming quarter.
sentences.zh: 這就結束了我簡報的財務概覽部分；現在我將轉到討論我們為下一季規劃的策略性計畫。

sentences.en: The success metrics outlined on this slide, developed in consultation with department heads, will be used to evaluate the effectiveness of our new training program.
sentences.zh: 這張投影片上列出的成功指標——與各部門主管協商後制定——將用於評估我們新培訓計畫的成效。

sentences.en: What makes this particular solution stand out from the alternatives, as I will demonstrate in the following slides, is its scalability and ease of integration with existing systems.
sentences.zh: 正如我將在接下來的投影片中展示的，這個特定解決方案之所以脫穎而出，在於它的可擴展性以及與現有系統整合的便利性。

sentences.en: I realize that I have covered a lot of information in a short time, so please feel free to interrupt me if anything needs further clarification or explanation.
sentences.zh: 我意識到我在短時間內涵蓋了大量資訊，所以如果有任何需要進一步澄清或解釋的地方，請隨時打斷我。

sentences.en: The recommendations I am presenting today are based on extensive research conducted by our team, including interviews with over fifty industry experts and key stakeholders.
sentences.zh: 我今天提出的建議是基於我們團隊進行的廣泛研究，包括對五十多位行業專家和關鍵利害關係人的訪談。

sentences.en: Looking at the dashboard metrics from last month, it becomes evident that our operational efficiency has improved significantly since implementing the automated workflow system.
sentences.zh: 觀察上個月的儀表板指標，很明顯自從實施自動化工作流程系統以來，我們的營運效率已顯著提升。

sentences.en: In the interest of time, I will skip the detailed breakdown of each region's performance and instead focus on the overall trends that are most relevant to our discussion today.
sentences.zh: 為了節省時間，我將跳過每個地區表現的詳細分析，改為聚焦在與今天討論最相關的整體趨勢。

sentences.en: The roadmap presented here, spanning the next eighteen months, outlines the key phases of development along with their respective milestones and resource requirements.
sentences.zh: 此處呈現的路線圖涵蓋未來十八個月，概述了開發的關鍵階段以及各自的里程碑和資源需求。

sentences.en: As we approach the end of this presentation, I want to reiterate that the success of this initiative depends heavily on cross-departmental collaboration and executive sponsorship.
sentences.zh: 隨著我們接近簡報尾聲，我想重申這項計畫的成功在很大程度上取決於跨部門合作和高層主管的支持。

sentences.en: Thank you all for your attention and insightful questions; I am confident that, with the strategies outlined today, we are well-positioned to achieve our ambitious goals.
sentences.zh: 感謝大家的關注和有見地的提問；我有信心，憑藉今天概述的策略，我們完全有能力實現我們的宏大目標。

sentences.en: If anyone would like to discuss any aspect of this presentation in greater detail, I will be available after the session or you may reach me via email at any time.
sentences.zh: 如果有人想更詳細地討論這份簡報的任何方面，我在會議結束後有空，或者您可以隨時透過電子郵件聯繫我。
